description: A food truck owner can spend at most $20000 on mangos and guavas. A mango costs the food truck owner $5 and a guava costs him $3. Spices are added and each mango is sold for a profit of $3 while each guava is sold for a profit of $4. The owner estimates that at least 100 mangos but at the most 150 are sold each month. He also estimates that the number of guavas sold is at most a third of the mangos sold. How many mangos and guavas should be sold in order to maximize the profit?

MaxSpendingBudget.definition: The maximum amount the owner can spend on mangos and guavas

CostMango.definition: The cost to purchase one mango

CostGuava.definition: The cost to purchase one guava

ProfitMango.definition: The profit earned from selling one mango

ProfitGuava.definition: The profit earned from selling one guava

MinMangosSold.definition: The minimum number of mangos sold each month

MaxMangosSold.definition: The maximum number of mangos sold each month

MaxGuavaToMangoRatio.definition: The maximum proportion of guavas sold relative to mangos sold

objective.description: "Maximize the total profit earned from selling mangos and guavas"

constraints.description: 5 * (number of mangos sold) + 3 * (number of guavas sold) ≤ 20000
The number of guavas sold should be at most one third of the number of mangos sold
The number of guavas sold should be non-negative

MangoSold.definition: The number of mangos sold each month

GuavaSold.definition: The number of guavas sold each month
